configuration.text: On stacked-prominent and inline-compact, the close button shows only when onClose is set or showClose is true; showClose false hides it even with onClose, and stacked-detailed never renders it.
The default button renders when buttonLabel or onPressButton is set; buttonSlot set to null removes it.
Leave Context to the Nudge: it sets the Nudge&Alert context itself, so its button is Figma's small size.

examples.purpose: A split-payment suggestion on a payment screen, in a lavender appearance; the screen handles the button and removes the nudge on close.
examples.jsx:
<Nudge
  title="Split payment"
  body="Pay ₹12,000 in 3 monthly instalments."
  buttonLabel="See plans"
  onPressButton={() => {}}
  onClose={() => {}}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light', AppearanceBrand: 'Secondary' }}
/>

from.quote: The screen handles its button and removes it on close.

examples.purpose: Inline compact, with no close button: one line of text with the button beside it.
examples.jsx:
<Nudge
  type="inline-compact"
  body="Set up autopay so you never miss a bill."
  buttonLabel="Set up"
  onPressButton={() => {}}
  showClose={false}
  modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}
/>

from.quote: One line of text with the button beside it. It has no title.

examples.purpose: Stacked detailed: a title over list items, with no button or close.
examples.jsx:
<Nudge type="stacked-detailed" title="Why split this payment?" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }}>
  <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="No extra cost" supportText="You pay ₹12,000 in total" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
  <ListItem layout="Horizontal" title="Three monthly payments" supportText="₹4,000 on the 5th of each month" modes={{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }} />
</Nudge>

from.quote: A title over list items explains the offer.

props.name: type
props.description: Controls the layout type. - "stacked-prominent": icon + title/body/button content - "inline-compact": icon + body/button in one row - "stacked-detailed": header + children detail slot. Default "stacked-prominent", from the component source.

props.name: title
props.description: On the web, with a title the card is a region named by the title; without one it has no role. Declared: Title text displayed in the nudge. Empty when omitted. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: body
props.description: Body text displayed in prominent and compact types when no children are provided. Empty when omitted. Default "", from the component source.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: Label for the default button. The default button renders only when this or `onPressButton` is set. `buttonSlot={null}` removes it.

props.name: onPressButton
props.description: Callback for the default button press. Also opts into the default button.

props.name: buttonSlot
props.description: null or false removes the button, leaving the title and body. Declared: Custom button slot. `null` or `false` removes the button. Omit to use `buttonLabel` / `onPressButton` when one of those is set.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Only reports the press; the screen removes the nudge. Declared: Called when the default close IconButton is pressed. When set, the close button is shown unless `showClose` is false.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Since a116616 (the #271 fix), Close renders only when onClose is set or showClose is true, and showClose false hides it even with onClose. Declared: Show the trailing close button on `stacked-prominent` and `inline-compact`. When omitted, the button shows only if `onClose` is set. Pass true to force it, or false to hide it. `stacked-detailed` never renders it.

props.name: closeAccessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the default close button. Default "Close", from the component source.

props.name: closeSlot
props.description: Replaces the default close, an IconButton ic_close labelled “Close” with forced Neutral / Low / S modes. Declared: Custom close slot, overrides the default close IconButton.

props.name: startSlot
props.description: Optional leading slot. Omit for the token-driven sparkle icon, pass null/false to hide.

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the title, body and button in stacked-prominent; the body and button in inline-compact; the list in stacked-detailed. Declared: Content slot — overrides default content, or provides detailed list content.

props.name: modes
props.description: Slot children get the Nudge's modes. Declared: Mode configuration for design token resolution.

modes.description: A token collection Nudge reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: In Color Mode Dark the title stays #1e1a14 on a dark card (#208): the title colour is one literal for every mode.
No appearance mode reproduces Figma's white card with a purple icon.
inline-compact never shows the title, but still uses it as the region's name, an invisible name.
onPressButton without buttonLabel renders an empty, unnamed button.
The sparkle icon isn't hidden from assistive tech on the web.
Nothing is announced and focus is not managed when a nudge is removed.
